title: Island Jelly — Argon vs Opus
titleZh: 果冻海岛：Argon 与 Opus 对比
description: A tactile island with waves, floating objects and a plush surfer. A detailed, self-contained Three.js prompt.
descriptionZh: 可交互的果冻海岛、波浪和毛绒冲浪角色，提供完整的 Three.js 实现要求。
reason: Highest engagement among the 47 public prompts. Detailed scene, UI, physics and single-file requirements can be adapted to other interactive dioramas.
reasonZh: 47 条公开提示词中互动最高；场景、交互、物理和单文件要求完整，可替换为其他微缩景观。
inputs: A static web server and browser. The prompt loads Three.js and fonts from public CDNs. The video compares multiple models; only the labelled Argon output belongs to Gemini 4.

title: Voxel Mercedes AMG F1 Car
description: A one-line starting point for a voxel vehicle. Swap the subject to explore a different product or vehicle.
descriptionZh: 一句话制作体素赛车，可替换车型或产品主题。
reason: Second-highest interaction total. Clear subject and visual style; easy to reuse by changing the vehicle.
reasonZh: 互动总量第二；主题和视觉风格明确，替换车型即可复用。
inputs: A coding workspace. The creator used Gemini 4 Argon High in Antigravity; the short prompt does not specify a renderer.

title: Fourier Epicycles — Mona Lisa
titleZh: 傅里叶圆周动画：蒙娜丽莎
description: A reusable reveal template: replace [thing], supply a style reference and synchronize a cinematic soundtrack.
descriptionZh: 替换 [thing]、提供风格参考图，将傅里叶绘制动画与电影感音乐同步。
reason: Third-highest interaction total and 86 bookmarks. An explicit subject placeholder makes this a reusable animation template.
reasonZh: 互动总量第三、86 次收藏；带有明确的主题占位符，适合反复使用。
inputs: A subject and style-reference image, plus Lyria 3.5 for the soundtrack as requested by the creator. The exact original reference image is not supplied in the prompt text.

title: Voxel Dragon Flying over a Temple
description: A compact character-and-environment brief. Change the creature, setting or visual style for a new scene.
descriptionZh: 简短的角色与环境描述，可替换生物、场景或视觉风格。
reason: Fourth-highest interaction total. The creature + action + environment structure is easy to adapt.
reasonZh: 互动总量第四；生物、动作、环境的结构清晰，便于替换。
inputs: A coding workspace. Choose the renderer and output format in a follow-up; the creator’s prompt only specifies the scene and voxel style.

title: Blender shrine
description: Generate a shrine with a Python script, materials, lighting and a camera, then export it as GLB.
descriptionZh: 用 Python 脚本生成神社，配置材质、灯光和相机，再导出 GLB。
reason: 96 likes, 15 reposts and 38 bookmarks. Specifies standard Blender APIs, procedural assets and GLB export; reusable for other architectural scenes.
reasonZh: 96 赞、15 转发、38 收藏；明确标准 API、程序化建模和 GLB 输出，可复用到建筑场景。
inputs: Blender 5.x with Python scripting. The public prompt is in Japanese and uses only Blender’s standard API.

title: 3D shooting game
description: A browser game with a warp intro, escalating enemies and a final boss, packaged in a single HTML file.
descriptionZh: 单个 HTML 文件承载浏览器射击游戏，包含跃迁开场、递进敌人和最终 Boss。
reason: 56 likes and 10 reposts. Clear single-file delivery, browser runtime and one-minute progression make this an accessible reusable game brief.
reasonZh: 56 赞、10 转发；交付格式、运行环境和一分钟流程清晰，适合作为游戏模板。
inputs: A coding workspace and a browser. The Japanese prompt asks for HTML, CSS and JavaScript combined into one HTML file.
